LESSON: EQUATIONS OF STRAIGHT LINES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Algebra
Topic 2.2: Equations of Straight Lines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Equations of Straight Lines. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the gradient in real-life situations

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: EQUATIONS OF STRAIGHT LINES
Equations of Straight Lines is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Equations of Straight Lines problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Equations of Straight Lines question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Equations of Straight Lines question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Equations of Straight Lines set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Equations of Straight Lines.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Equations of Straight Lines in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the gradient in real-life situations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
